editorialSummary.heading: Dates Socorro ISD families need for 2026-2027
highlights: July 27 first day and May 27 last day
175 instructional days listed on the district calendar
Three early-release dates for students and teachers
Two student intersession periods; check with your campus about eligibility
paragraphs: Socorro ISD students began the 2026-2027 school year on Monday, July 27, 2026, and the last day of school is Thursday, May 27, 2027. The district calendar lists 175 instructional days: 86 in the fall and 89 in the spring.

SISD's 2026-2027 calendar lists two student intersessions: September 28–October 9 and March 15–19. The calendar does not specify which students are assigned to attend, so families should confirm participation with their campus. Thanksgiving break is November 23–27, winter break is December 21–January 4, and spring break is March 22–26.

Students and teachers have early release on November 3, December 18 and May 27; the district calendar does not list dismissal times. Staff development on January 4–5 means students return from winter break on January 6. After spring break, Easter Monday on March 29 and staff development on March 30 keep students out until March 31.

about.dataSource: Dates and calendar terminology come from Socorro ISD's board-approved 2026-2027 Student Calendar and the district's Student Calendars page. The district's July 29 opening-news report independently confirms the July 27 first student day.
about.processing: Student holidays, breaks, early-release dates, intersessions and nine-weeks milestones are included. July 27 is both the first student day and the first-nine-weeks start, corroborated by the PDF's In Session shading and the district news report. Intersession dates are not counted as confirmed districtwide no-school days because participation is unspecified. Staff-development dates are included only where they affect the student schedule. Open house dates are covered in FAQs, but open house events, teacher workdays outside the student year and the June–July district closure are omitted from events.
about.updates: The calendar is identified as board approved February 18, 2026. This page was checked against the official calendar and district opening-news report on October 6, 2026.
about.disclaimer: The PDF does not say which students are assigned to fall or spring intersession, and it does not list early-release times. Confirm intersession participation, dismissal details and testing assignments with your student's campus. The PDF also notes that state assessment dates may change by TEA.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Socorro ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Monday, July 27, 2026.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Socorro ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. It is also an early-release day for students and teachers.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are in the Socorro ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Socorro ISD lists 175 instructional days for 2026-2027: 86 in the fall and 89 in the spring.

faqs.question: When is Socorro ISD's fall intersession?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists fall intersession for students from September 28 through October 9, 2026. It does not specify which students are assigned to attend, so check with your campus.

faqs.question: Who attends Socorro ISD's fall and spring intersessions?
faqs.answer: The district calendar labels September 28–October 9 and March 15–19 as intersession for students, but it does not specify which students are assigned to attend. Families should confirm their student's intersession schedule with their campus.

faqs.question: Does Socorro ISD have a fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Socorro ISD does not use the term "fall break" on its 2026-2027 calendar. Instead, it lists Fall Intersession for Students from September 28 through October 9, followed by staff development October 12–13. The second nine weeks begins October 14. The calendar does not specify which students attend intersession.

faqs.question: When is Socorro ISD Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return to class Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Socorro ISD winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists winter break from December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. Staff development is also scheduled January 4-5, so students return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: Is there school on January 4 or 5, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Socorro ISD schedules staff development January 4–5; January 4 is also part of Winter Break. Students return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: When is Socorro ISD spring intersession in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring intersession for students is listed March 15-19, 2027. The PDF does not say which students are assigned to attend; confirm the schedule with your campus.

faqs.question: When is Socorro ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. Easter Monday and staff development follow, so students return Wednesday, March 31.

faqs.question: Are Socorro ISD students off March 29 and 30, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, March 29, is the Easter Monday holiday, and Tuesday, March 30, is a staff development day. Students return Wednesday, March 31.

faqs.question: Which days have early release in Socorro ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists early release for students and teachers on Election Day, November 3, 2026, December 18, 2026, and the last day of school, May 27, 2027. It does not provide dismissal times.

faqs.question: Is there school in Socorro ISD on Election Day?
faqs.answer: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, is an early-release day for students and teachers. The district calendar does not state the dismissal time, so check with your campus.

faqs.question: Does Socorro ISD have school on Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is listed as a Veterans Day holiday on the student calendar.

faqs.question: Is Socorro ISD closed on Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: Monday, September 7, 2026, is listed as the Labor Day holiday, so students do not have classes.

faqs.question: Is there school in Socorro ISD on Martin Luther King Jr. Day?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is listed as the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday.

faqs.question: What are the Socorro ISD nine-week grading-period dates?
faqs.answer: The first nine weeks begins July 27 and ends September 25. The second runs October 14–December 18, and the third runs January 6–March 12. The fourth begins March 31, and the last day of school is May 27.

faqs.question: Does the Socorro ISD calendar show STAAR or other state testing dates?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks state assessment dates and a TELPAS testing window, but it does not provide a student-by-student testing schedule. It notes that TEA assessment dates may change; check with your campus for assignments.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official SISD calendar for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The official 2026-2027 Student Calendar PDF is linked on this page and through Socorro ISD's Student Calendars page.

faqs.question: When are Socorro ISD fall open house nights in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists Fall Middle School Open House on September 8, Elementary/PK-8 Open House on September 9, and High School Open House on September 10, 2026.

faqs.question: When are Socorro ISD spring open house nights in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists Spring Middle School Open House on February 23, Elementary/K-8 Open House on February 24, and High School Open House on February 25, 2027.
